     3| (MVP plan, Sections 3.1 and 9).

     5| The only write path into the graph from an approval. Two invariants it
     6| exists to guarantee:

     9|      window and appends a new one. History stays queryable, which is what
    10|      makes point-in-time reconstruction and audit possible at all.
    11| 
    12|   2. All-or-nothing. The whole change set applies in one transaction. A
    13|      partially-applied change set would leave the graph describing a
    14|      workflow that was never approved in that form -- worse than either
    15|      applying it or not.
